mapper.select: select user_id, res_id, res_check_in, res_state, res_created_time from reservation_master where user_id = #{userId}

select rd.item_id from reservation_master rm join reservation_detail rd ON rm.res_id = rd.res_id where rm.res_check_in = TO_DATE(#{resCheckIn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') or(rm.res_check_in = TO_DATE(#{resCheckIn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '1' DAY and rm.res_check_out - rm.res_check_in = 2)
select rm.* from reservation_master rm join reservation_detail rd on rm.res_id = rd.res_id where rd.item_id = #{itemId} and rm.res_check_in = TO_DATE(#{resCheckIn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
mapper.insert: insert into reservation_master (user_id, res_check_in, res_check_out) values (#{userId}, #{resCheckIn}, #{resCheckOut})
insert into reservation_detail (res_id, item_id, item_quantity, item_amount) values (#{resId}, #{itemId}, #{itemQuantity}, #{itemAmount})
mapper.delete: delete from reservation_master where user_id = #{userId} and res_state = 0
